about: A Python tool that pulls the main text and metadata out of web pages.

prs.title: Markdown output keeps quotes marked as quotes
prs.broken: In Markdown output, a quote on a web page came out as plain paragraphs, so it could not be told apart from the text around it.
prs.changed: Each line of a quote now gets the Markdown quote mark, and lists or code inside the quote stay inside it.
prs.matters: Pages saved as Markdown keep their quotes, so who said what stays clear.
